content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Mungeli District Court Assistant Grade III Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://mungeli.dcourts.gov.in. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Mungeli District Court Assistant Grade-03 recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Mungeli District Court Assistant Grade-03 recruitment is 12th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Grade-03 post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Assistant Grade-03 post, candidates must be a Graduate from a recognized university and possess a 1-year Computer Diploma from a recognized board or university. Knowledge of Hindi and English typing, along with the local language (Chhattisgarhi), is also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Mungeli District Court Assistant Grade-03 positions?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxations are provided as per government rules for specific categories and Chhattisgarh domiciles.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Grade-03 post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Assistant Grade-03 post, which includes roles such as Evidence Writer, Office Typist, Order Writer, and Sale Amin.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Grade-03 position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Grade-03 post will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 19,500 to Rs. 62,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Mungeli District Court Assistant Grade-03 recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection criteria for the Assistant Grade-03 posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Grade-03 posts will involve a Written Test followed by a Skill Test. Candidates need to perform well in both stages to be considered for the final selection.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the Mungeli District Court Assistant Grade-03 recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Mungeli District Court, which is https://mungeli.dcourts.gov.in. Links are also provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and technical certificates, along with the filled application form.
